#   tools/link/fnvlink.py resolve --override render/native/overrides.tsv   (feature request R1 in REQUESTS.md)

#   address: hex function address, or vslot:<MSVC vftable symbol>:<slot index> for a virtual whose implementation
#            address the image vftable holds (R1b: the linker reads the slot and treats the row as that address).

# REQUESTS.md R2). Identified from the decomp bodies; signatures = the decomp definitions at these addresses.
